Sunday, 9 pm
Badminton with Rekha again this morning. Week fourteen, I counted. It started because the court downstairs needed two players and we both happened to be standing there with rackets in April.
Now it's a thing. Sunday, 7 am, then chai on the bench. Today she told me about her dad's surgery and I told her about the job I didn't get. We weren't trying to be deep. It just came out between games.
I used to think I needed a big group and loads of invites. I have maybe three people now: Rekha, Deepa from work, and Anu on the phone every Wednesday. It's enough. More than enough.
Note to self, Simran: don't skip next Sunday, even if it rains. Rain just means chai without the badminton.

qa.q: What might the Sunday mornings mean to Rekha?
qa.a: Rekha trusted Simran enough to talk about her dad's surgery, so the mornings may be a steady comfort for her too.
